tasks.extra: Required CI: the single `ci` job in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, the only check this repo's workflows define. It runs `bun run lint`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun test`, `bun run validate:examples`, and `bun run build`. CodeRabbit, GitGuardian and Socket also report on PRs; they are not required, but read them before merging. `main` has no branch protection and the repo sets `allow_auto_merge: false`, so `gh pr merge --auto` is not a gate here: it would leave the PR unmerged, not wait for anything. Read the `ci` conclusion, then `gh pr merge --squash`, per `prompts/child.md`. Never auto-merge release-please PRs. Children must use the OpenCode v2 runtime (`opencode2`, equivalent to the local `opencode` v2 binary) with model `opencode/space-bunny-free`; confirm the model before editing. Do not run heavy local Node/build/test tasks: rely on CI for lint, typecheck, tests, and builds. Children may open PRs. Manager does not implement on `main`. Reuse before spawning: one long-lived manager session, one worktree per issue, and re-prompt a child already working the issue instead of duplicating it. Clean up a child worktree only after its PR merged. State is local; do not commit `.herdr-desk/runs/`.
